newsitem.title: USA: Central Newspapers buys job fair firm.
newsitem.headline: Central Newspapers buys job fair firm.

text.p: Central Newspapers Inc., through its Westech group of companies, said Wednesday it acquired the assets of Target Career Fairs, which organises job fairs for the high-tech industry.
Terms of the all-cash transaction were not disclosed but the company said it did not expect the deal to dilute its earnings.
Target Career Fairs, a closely held company based in Boston, has annual sales of about $3 million.
Central Newspapers, based in Indianapolis, is a media company that publishes daily, Sunday and weekly newspapers.
Its stock rose 44 cents to $73 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
